title: EXAMPLE - The Road to the Market
audience: EXAMPLE: replace with your real audience. Grandchildren in the diaspora aged 15-30, watching on phones in WhatsApp family groups and on TikTok.
intent: EXAMPLE: replace. They should feel the weight of what one ordinary walk cost, and want to call their grandmother and ask her for the rest of the story.

style.description: Warm hand-painted look, soft film grain, golden early-morning light, muted earth tones of ochre, terracotta and eucalyptus green, gentle depth of field, highland Ethiopian landscape
style.negative: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, distorted face, modern cars, plastic

characters.name: Etete
characters.description: a slender Ethiopian woman in her early twenties with warm dark-brown skin, an oval face, a small gap between her front teeth, hair braided close to the scalp in thin cornrows, wearing a white cotton habesha dress with a narrow green-yellow-red tibeb border and a white netela shawl over her shoulders, barefoot

voice.style_prompt: Read this slowly and warmly, like an elder telling a story to her grandchildren in the evening, with small pauses:

music.prompt: gentle Ethiopian krar and masinko, soft kebero hand drum, warm, nostalgic, sparse, cinematic, slow build, instrumental

lines: For Etete, who walked it every Saturday.
Made with AI: images, motion, music and voice are AI-generated from a family story told with consent.

shots.purpose: Establish place and time before any person: the world she walked through.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of misty highland hills at dawn, a narrow dirt path winding between eucalyptus trees toward a distant town
shots.motion_prompt: mist drifting slowly across the hills, eucalyptus leaves trembling in a light breeze

narration.text: Every Saturday, before the sun was up, my grandmother walked to the market.
narration.translation_en: Every Saturday, before the sun was up, my grandmother walked to the market.

shots.purpose: Introduce her face, so the audience bonds with a person rather than a landscape.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of a young woman tying her white netela shawl inside a dim round tukul hut, lit by the glow of a small charcoal fire
shots.motion_prompt: she pulls the shawl around her shoulders, firelight flickering on her face

narration.text: She was twenty years old. The basket on her head held everything we had to sell.
narration.translation_en: She was twenty years old. The basket on her head held everything we had to sell.

shots.purpose: Show the stakes: the basket is the family's income.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of hands arranging eggs and bundles of green coffee beans in a woven sefed basket on a mud floor
shots.motion_prompt: her hands gently place the last egg, the basket rocks slightly

narration.text: Eggs from our hens. Coffee from the tree behind the house. Not much, but it was ours.
narration.translation_en: Eggs from our hens. Coffee from the tree behind the house. Not much, but it was ours.

shots.purpose: The journey: scale of the distance, her small figure in a big land.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme wide shot of a lone young woman walking barefoot along a ridge path at sunrise, a basket balanced on her head, long shadow
shots.motion_prompt: she walks steadily from left to right, shawl moving in the wind, sun rising behind the hills

narration.text: Three hours there. Three hours back. She never once let the basket fall.
narration.translation_en: Three hours there. Three hours back. She never once let the basket fall.

shots.purpose: Arrival: noise, colour and life after the quiet of the road.
shots.image_prompt: A busy open-air highland market, women in white shawls under woven umbrellas, piles of red berbere and onions, donkeys, warm dust in the air
shots.motion_prompt: people moving between stalls, dust glowing in the light, an umbrella turning

narration.text: At the market she bargained like a merchant twice her age.
narration.translation_en: At the market she bargained like a merchant twice her age.

shots.purpose: Her character: confidence and humour, not only hardship.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the young woman laughing as she hands a coffee bundle to an older trader across a wooden stall
shots.motion_prompt: she laughs and tilts her head, the trader counts coins into her palm

narration.text: She always said: a soft word sells more coffee than a loud voice.
narration.translation_en: She always said: a soft word sells more coffee than a loud voice.

shots.purpose: The turn: what the money became, connecting her walk to the narrator's life.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a few coins and a folded paper note tucked into a small cloth pouch beside a child's school notebook and pencil on a wooden table
shots.motion_prompt: lamplight flickers, a breeze lifts the notebook page

narration.text: Every coin went into a cloth pouch. That pouch paid for my father's school books.
narration.translation_en: Every coin went into a cloth pouch. That pouch paid for my father's school books.

shots.purpose: The walk home at dusk, mirroring the opening to close the circle.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of the young woman walking home along the same ridge path at dusk, empty basket under her arm, purple sky
shots.motion_prompt: she walks slowly away from camera, first stars appearing, grass moving

narration.text: She came home in the dark, tired, and proud.
narration.translation_en: She came home in the dark, tired, and proud.

shots.purpose: Land the intent: the audience is the continuation of her walk.
shots.image_prompt: The same dirt path in morning light today, empty, with fresh footprints in the dust leading toward the town
shots.motion_prompt: dust settles in the footprints, light slowly brightens

narration.text: I have never walked that road. But every step I take today, I take on hers.
narration.translation_en: I have never walked that road. But every step I take today, I take on hers.
